rule.statement: A transferee who obtains a transfer while a mortgage bond is still in force and acknowledges payment prior to execution may not be considered a bona fide purchaser for value.
rule.supporting_quote: In fact, the 3rd Defendant opted to obtain a transfer while a mortgage bond was still in force. Moreover, the attestation of the notary in Deed No. 2597, marked ‘A10’, executed for the purpose of transferring the property to the 3rd Defendant, states that the consideration had been acknowledged as paid prior to the execution.
